data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's evidence criterion is question-begging: it asks what evidence distinguishes genuine reliability from mere compliance that tracks the right answer, then answers with 'they deviate from the checklist but still get the right verifiable outcome.' But a panel that merely happens to track the right answer can also deviate from the checklist and still be correct by luck, so the deviation+correct-outcome pattern does not separate the two. To make it discriminating, the panel must be right 'because' it recognized a nuance the checklist missed (SCR_009), i.e., the correctness must be attributable to the deviation; but the target never specifies how a single evaluation evidences that attribution. It supplies a pattern (Residual Error Profile) without an identification rule, so the very distinction the problem asks it to name is left unoperationalized.
